ops.title: HANDOFF: File Provider overlay backend Part 2 (Swift + cc-pool wiring) through end
ops.body:
# HANDOFF — File Provider overlay backend, Part 2 → end

**Status:** Phase 1 (fusekit FP scaffolding) is DONE and on `fusekit` main (commit `898cc4f5`,
"feat(overlay): File Provider backend scaffolding"). Base: fusekit `v0.14.2` (safety net) + the FP
commit on main (unreleased). It compiles and its tests pass via `scripts/test.sh`. It is **dormant in
production**: `overlay.FileProviderAvailable` gates selection on a signed host app + bundle that does
not exist yet, and no consumer wires `Spec.FileProvider`. Resume from Phase 2.

**Goal:** a macOS File Provider (`NSFileProviderReplicatedExtension`) as the default overlay on macOS —
no kernel mount, no cgo, no "Network Volumes" TCC grant, OS-managed lifecycle that survives process
death/reboot. The pure-Go default build gets a live overlay for the first time. It is the 4th
`overlay.Backend` ("fileprovider"), inside fusekit (not a new cc-pool Kind).

**Already built in Phase 1 (fusekit, on main):**
- `fusekit/fileproviderd`: control proto (Health/Probe/Register/Path/Signal/Remove), AppSpawn
  (`open -g` + wait), RemoteDomainHost, BridgeServer + the **`ContentSource` seam**
  (Manifest/ReadSynth/WriteThrough/Classify), atomic fail-closed symlink. Pure-Go.
- `overlay` FP arms: `BackendFileProvider`, `FileProviderProvider` (wraps RemoteDomainHost;
  PrivateRoot=FusePrivateRoot), `Select`/`ProviderFor`/`FileProviderAvailable`/`Enablement`,
  `Spec.FileProvider *FileProviderSpec`, `fpavail_{darwin,other}.go`.

**Two hard realities (Apple-confirmed):**
1. A domain surfaces under `~/Library/CloudStorage/<App>-<DisplayName>/`, not an arbitrary path. But
   `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` MUST stay `~/.cc-pool/accounts/acct-NN` (that literal string is SHA-256'd into
   the Keychain service name — NFC, NOT realpath-resolved). **Bridge: keep `acct-NN` a symlink into the
   domain root** (hash is on the literal string, survives).
2. A File Provider needs the entitlement — can't be a plain Go binary. **Host the extension + a
   domain-controller inside cc-pool's `widget/` app (CCPoolStatus.app);** the Go side drives it over a
   socket (the FP analog of the detached mount-holder).

## Phase 2 — Swift extension + host controller + packaging (cc-pool `widget/`)
- `widget/Sources/FileProvider/FileProviderExtension.swift` — `NSFileProviderReplicatedExtension`. Item
  ids: `rootContainer`, `shared:<relpath>`, `private:<name>`, `computed:.claude.json`,
  `computed:settings.json`. `enumerator(.rootContainer)`→Go Manifest; `.workingSet`=top shared dirs +
  both computed (signal target); `enumerateChanges`=snapshot-with-versions; `fetchContents`:
  shared/private→clone backing file, computed→Go ReadSynth; create/modify/delete→Classify + route
  (shared→`~/.claude`, private→store, computed→WriteThrough). Resolve real home via **getpwuid**
  (NSHomeDirectory in an appex = the container). Materialize OFF the main thread; use
  `NSFileCoordinator` for writes (uncoordinated writes to dataless files can be silently reverted).
- `widget/Sources/App/FileProviderController.swift` — binds `~/.cc-pool/domains.sock`, serves control,
  `NSFileProviderManager.add/remove`, returns `getUserVisibleURL(.rootContainer)` to Go (for the
  symlink), runs the `~/.claude` watcher → `signalEnumerator(.workingSet)`. Start beside
  `StatusWatcher.start()`.
- `widget/project.yml` — new `app-extension` `CCPoolFileProvider`: `NSExtensionPointIdentifier:
  com.apple.fileprovider-nonui`, `NSExtensionFileProviderDocumentGroup: $(TeamIdentifierPrefix)ccp`,
  entitlements `app-sandbox` + `application-groups: [$(TeamIdentifierPrefix)ccp]` (**Team-ID-prefixed,
  SHORT** — bridge socket lives in `~/Library/Group Containers/<TEAMID>.ccp/`, 104-byte sun_path limit)
  + `temporary-exception.files.home-relative-path.read-write: [/.claude/, /.cc-pool/]` (resolves to
  REAL home; pair with getpwuid). **NO `testing-mode`** (restricted/dev-only; forces a profile + breaks
  the no-profile Developer ID release — TN3125). Host app gets the SAME `application-groups` and STAYS
  non-sandboxed (App Groups needed even for non-sandboxed code to reach the Group Container on macOS
  15+). Host needs NO FP-specific entitlement to call add/remove. Embed+codeSign the appex into
  CCPoolStatus.
- **Signing:** App-Group ID must be Team-ID-prefixed + domain registration needs a real Team ID, so FP
  appex + host **cannot be ad-hoc signed**. Build `CODE_SIGN_STYLE: Manual` + Developer ID +
  `DEVELOPMENT_TEAM` — **no provisioning profile** (all FP entitlements are unrestricted). Gate the FP
  target behind a separate scheme so local ad-hoc widget builds keep working. Local FP iteration needs a
  free Personal Team or the Developer ID cert (ad-hoc can't register a domain). See the
  `cc-pool-fileprovider-signing-reality` memory.
- Widget build on macOS 26 needs Xcode 26 (SDK-skew whiteout): `setup-xcode "~> 26.0"` before the
  widget xcodebuild (see `cc-pool-widget-macos26-sdk-skew`).

## Phase 3 — cc-pool blind-consumer wiring (thin)
- `internal/pool/overlay.go` (`overlaySpec`) — add `FileProvider: &fkoverlay.FileProviderSpec{AppPath:
  WidgetAppPath(), ControlSocket, BridgeSocket, ExtensionBundleID, AppGroup, SpawnTimeout}`.
  `DetectOverlayBackend()` unchanged (Select now considers FP first).
- A new cc-pool type implementing `fileproviderd.ContentSource` over `MergeClaudeJSON`/`SplitClaudeJSON`
  (internal/overlay/claudejson.go), `injectPlansDirectory`/strip (settings.go), classify (classify.go),
  + `mergeKey`/`settingsKey` for versions. Hosted by the daemon (Phase 4) — the FP analog of
  `InProcessFuse()`.
- `internal/pool/paths.go` — `WidgetAppPath()`, `FPControlSocketPath()` (`~/.cc-pool/domains.sock`),
  `FPBridgeSocketPath()` (Group Container, kept short; learn `<TEAMID>.ccp` from the embedded appex's
  `NSExtensionFileProviderDocumentGroup`).
- **No change** to persistence, the add flow, the keychain hash (literal `acct-NN`), or `run.go`
  (`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` = literal `AccountDir(n)`). Generic `MovePrivateEntries`/`MoveSharedOrphans` cover
  FP⇄FUSE⇄symlink (private roots coincide via `FusePrivateRoot`).

## Phase 4 — daemon reconcile/signal + doctor + migrate + release
- `internal/daemon/fileprovider.go` — hosts BridgeServer (cc-pool ContentSource); ensures the widget app
  is running; `reconcileFileProviderDomains` on the supervise tick (re-Setup on Health failure,
  idempotent, no breakers); targeted `signalDomain{acct}` after base mutations. `reconcileAccount` gains
  a `BackendFileProvider` arm. Fuse Supervisor/carcass/breaker untouched. Teardown reuses the idle gate
  (`procscan.CountByConfigDir == 0`).
- doctor: `prov.Health` covers FP; add `reportFileProvider` + `checkFileProviderFallback`. migrate:
  `ccp migrate --to fileprovider` is the macOS default, gated on `FileProviderAvailable`; no
  auto-migration; new pools default to FP via Select.
- release.yml: assert `CCPoolFileProvider.appex` exists + carries `application-groups` + declares the
  document group + the `fileprovider-nonui` point. **The cc-pool daemon binary** gains
  `com.apple.security.application-groups: [<TEAMID>.ccp]` in its codesign (pure + fuse) so the
  non-sandboxed daemon can bind the BridgeServer socket in the Group Container.

## Phase 5 — flip the macOS default + e2e validation
The FP arm in `Select` already prefers FP when available; validate with a real pooled session (register
→ symlinked `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` → merged `.claude.json` read, shared-key write splits back, external
`~/.claude` edit re-enumerates). Loop validate→fix.

## Discipline & risks
- **ALL Go test runs via `scripts/test.sh`** (ulimit-capped) — never bare `go test`. Widget builds via
  the Team-signed xcodebuild scheme.
- Sandboxed appex file access: temp-exception read-write may be honored inconsistently → getpwuid +
  route content through the Go data channel if denied; symlink stays the floor, Select's probe gates
  adoption.
- Team signing: ship FP only in the release cask; gate behind a separate scheme.
- Replica staleness: bulk served direct-from-`~/.claude` + version-stamped computed items; host watcher
  + daemon signalDomain cover both; SplitClaudeJSON is idempotent/additive so out-of-order writes
  converge.
- This feature shares the signed-cask + ContentSource rails with the multi-tenant `fusekit-holder`
  daemon (Phase 3 of the remediation) — sequence them together where the cask/signing overlaps.
ops.when: resuming the File Provider overlay backend feature; Phase 1 fusekit scaffolding is on fusekit main (v0.14.2+), start at Phase 2 — Swift NSFileProviderReplicatedExtension, host controller, widget AppGroup packaging, cc-pool ContentSource wiring, daemon reconcile, release CI, flip macOS default
